phoenix_trace_context.description: This guidance applies when the user is viewing a trace in the UI, i.e., when `ui_contexts` has a `trace` entry.
phoenix_trace_context.guidance: - `projectNodeId` scopes the trace; `otelTraceId` identifies it. Use `otelTraceId` when linking to it as `[label](/redirects/traces/)`. - When the user asks about "this trace", "this run", or "what went wrong here", they mean this trace. Read its spans before answering rather than reasoning from the ID alone. - When a `session` entry is also present, this trace is the currently selected turn within that session.
